CustomField.description: One line for the pushed record's description: source, solicitation or RFQ number, vehicle, due date and link.
CustomField.formula: IF(Source_Feed__c = "EMAIL_GSA_eBuy", "GSA eBuy RFQ", TEXT(Notice_Type__c)) & " (Nexus " & Notice_Id__c & ")" & IF(ISBLANK(Solicitation_Number__c), "", " · Solicitation " & Solicitation_Number__c) & IF(ISBLANK(Contract_Vehicle__c), "", " · Vehicle " & Contract_Vehicle__r.Name) & IF(ISBLANK(Response_Due__c), "", " · Responses due " & TEXT(DATEVALUE(Response_Due__c))) & IF(ISBLANK(Notice_URL__c), "", " · " & Notice_URL__c)
CustomField.label: Push Details
